sections_target.text: Spare parts that may be changed as required:
Work steps to be carried out

rows: Disconnect the coupling and drain the pump oil.
Disconnect the instrument and gauge connections.
Dismantle the balance drum, remove it and inspect it.
Lift the pump by the prepared rigging and place it on wooden blocks on the ground.
Using the pump's special tools, remove the stages in sequence after removing the spacer sleeve between each stage and the next.
Check the clearance of the stationary and rotating impellers.
After inspection and verifying the condition, replace as required and reassemble in reverse order.
After the repair and reinstallation are complete, run the pump and check the condition in terms of:

- Vibration - discharge pressure and quantity - motor operating current
- Oil pressure - balance drum pressure -
Mechanical seal
Bearing temperature
in accordance with the performance curves

Introduction
This document covers the periodic maintenance of the boiler feed pump. The document was prepared by Eng. Mohamed Salim Salman and Eng. Ahmed Mostafa El-Sabbagh on 14 June 2003, and the electronic correspondence was carried out over the Internet with the assistance of Eng. Mohamed Salim Salman.
It was implemented based on previous experience by Eng. Ahmed Mostafa El-Sabbagh. The document was reviewed by Eng. Abouda El-Banna, Inspection and Quality Control Engineer, and Eng. Mohamed El-Sayed Abdel Ghaffar, General Manager of the station, and approved by Eng. Awad Mohamed Fathy, Head of the Power Stations Sector.
Safety precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority.
Fence off the work area and place warning signs.
Use safety equipment: helmet, shoes and ear muffs.
Isolate the pump electrically and take the switch out of service.
Isolate the pump mechanically by closing the discharge and suction valves and the bearing cooling valve.
Tools, instruments and equipment used
Helmet and safety shoes
Chain block or Tirfor and its accessories (wire ropes and locks).
Complete tool set: wrenches of all types, open-end, ring and Allen keys.
Vernier caliper and dial caliper.
8-inch puller and feeler gauge.
Wooden blocks.
Spare parts that may be changed as required:
Remarks | Quantity | Item | No.
Imported | 1 | Thrust bearing | 1
Imported | 2 | Slide bearing | 2
Imported | 1 | Balance drum | 3
Manufactured in the station workshop | 10 | Spacer sleeve | 4
Imported | 1 | Shaft | 5
Imported | 2 | Mechanical seal | 6
Work steps to be carried out
Open the work order. | 1
Disconnect the pump. | 2
Disconnect the coupling and drain the pump oil. | 3
Disconnect the instrument and gauge connections. | 4
Dismantle the gear oil pump. | 5
Dismantle the front slide bearing. | 6
Dismantle the front thrust bearing. | 7
Dismantle the balance drum, remove it and inspect it. | 8
Dismantle the rear slide bearing. | 9
Inspect the bearings. | 10
Dismantle the pump insulation drum. | 11
Undo the pump base bolts. | 12
Lift the pump by the prepared rigging and place it on wooden blocks on the ground. | 13
Using the pump's special tools, remove the stages in sequence after removing the spacer sleeve between each stage and the next. | 14
Check the clearance of the stationary and rotating impellers. | 15
After inspection and verifying the condition, replace as required and reassemble in reverse order. | 16
After the repair and reinstallation are complete, run the pump and check the condition in terms of: | 17
- Vibration - discharge pressure and quantity - motor operating current
- Oil pressure - balance drum pressure -
Mechanical seal
Bearing temperature
in accordance with the performance curves | 18
